messages:
Alex: Customer wants a 2-week POC. They asked for a scoped API key (no embeddings), a Dedicated pool reservation for inference, and SSO + least-privilege invites. Need a checklist and exact steps we give them.
Jamie (SE): Thanks — which parts are manual vs can we automate via a template?
Tim (DevOps): We can automate most. Flow I recommend: create isolated workspace -> invite POC engineers with a scoped role -> issue ephemeral API key (14d expiry) scoped to generation only -> reserve a small Dedicated pool in us-west1 (1 node, gpus) -> apply network allowlist if they want VPC egress blocked.
Maria (Security): A few Qs from their security team: audit log retention (default 90d, can extend), key rotation policy, can we disable model telemetry, encryption with customer-managed KMS? Also want confirmation that Dedicated pools provide tenant isolation (yes).
Jamie (SE): For invites/roles what do we call the role? "poc-engineer" with minimal perms? It should allow create-routes, call-model, view-costs false.
Tim (DevOps): Suggested role mapping: poc-engineer: call/infer + view-logs; poc-admin: full config (only for Redwood SE). Create a service account for CI with token rotation. Use SCIM to auto-provision from Okta if they want SSO sync.
Alex: They also asked about Hosted API keys vs Dedicated: they want to start on Hosted for quick tests, then flip traffic to Dedicated for load. How do we make keys least-privilege?
ProvisionBot: Generated ephemeral key: sk-ephem-01xxx (expires 2026-04-06T18:34:05Z). Use: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ephem-..." https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Maria (Security): Add to checklist: IP allowlist, disable logs forwarding to third parties, confirm no data stored beyond caching TTL (we enforce 24h max for POC unless they opt-in), KMS wrap keys required for Private deployments.
Jamie (SE): I'll draft a terraform snippet they can run to create the workspace + role bindings. Example:
```
module "redwood_workspace" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-workspaces//modules/poc"
  name   = "acme-poc"
  region = "us-west1"
}
```
Then `redwoodctl invite --workspace acme-poc --role poc-engineer --email dev@acme.com`
Tim (DevOps): Dedicated pool notes: minimum 1-week reserve for discounted pricing, but we can do on-demand gpus for trial to avoid commit. Estimate: ~ $X/day (will confirm). Also enforce cost cap via billing alerts + per-key quota.
Alex: Security questionnaire: Maria, can you draft the short answers we can paste into their doc? They'll want simple yes/no + short paragraph on isolation and encryption.
Maria (Security): Will do. I'll cover: dedicated isolation, KMS support (customer-managed keys for Private), audit trail retention, SSO + SCIM, service-account best practices (rotate every 7 days for ephemeral keys), and confirmation that Hosted API keys are scoped and logged.
Jamie (SE): Action items for us: 1) send POC invite flow doc 2) generate ephemeral key and give example curl 3) propose Dedicated vs Hosted cost comparison 4) provide terraform snippet and SCIM guide. I can assemble and send today.
Tim (DevOps): I'll add the network/VPC instructions and a short runbook for IP allowlist + internal-only endpoints. Also note: if they require HSM-backed KMS, that's only on Private deployments.
Alex: Perfect. Once Jamie posts the packet I'll @customer-success to schedule onboarding call. :thumbsup:
ProvisionBot: Note: audit logging enabled for workspace acme-poc by default. Logs retention = 90d.
Alex: Thanks everyone — please flag anything missing, otherwise I'll send the POC packet after Jamie's draft.
